screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.readonly_: Operators can edit via this screen or /dogsunleashed
screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.noworld_h: Join a singleplayer world or server to view and edit these settings
screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.spawn.too: When on, dogs spawn in the wild in their home biomes, both when new chunks generate and near players over time. When off, dogs only come from spawn eggs and breeding. Spawn Near Players follows the change right away. Biome spawns, in new chunks and from vanilla's animal spawning, change after a world restart.
screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.graves.to: When enabled, a grave block appears when a tamed dog dies. Disable to drop loot normally instead.
screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.dropleash: When enabled, sneak-right-clicking a leashed dog with a fetch toy drops the leash before play mode starts. When disabled, the dog stays leashed and pauses fetching until the leash comes off.
screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.shownames: When enabled, a named dog shows its name floating above its head. Disable to hide every dog name in the world without renaming anything.
screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.spawnrate: How often every breed spawns in the wild, compared with the default. 200% is about twice as many dogs, 50% about half, and 0% none at all. It applies both when new chunks generate and to spawning near players. Spawn Near Players follows the change right away. Biome spawns, in new chunks and from vanilla's animal spawning, change after a world restart.

How often this breed spawns in the wild, compared with its default. It multiplies with the global Spawn Rate, so 200% here and 150% there is 3 times as many. 0% stops this breed spawning in the wild. Spawn Near Players follows the change right away. Biome spawns, in new chunks and from vanilla's animal spawning, change after a world restart.
screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.capindepe: Every minute or two, tries to spawn a wild group of a breed that lives in the biome near a player, even where vanilla's animal limit is full, such as explored land or servers with other creature mods. Covers every breed, dire wolf packs included. It waits while 2 or more wild groups are within 64 blocks of the player. Wild dogs from it despawn when no player is near, unless tamed. Changes apply right away.
screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.autosleep: When enabled, tamed dogs walk to their assigned bed at nightfall and sleep until morning.
How far away a dog can be from its assigned bed and still return to sleep at night.
screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.barkvolum: Scales the volume of all dog bark sounds. Set to 0.0 to mute barks.
screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.howlvolum: Scales the volume of Husky and dire wolf howls. Set to 0.0 to mute howls.

screen.dogs-unleashed.dog_inspect.title: Dog Details
screen.dogs-unleashed.dog_inspect.too_wi: Too wild to tame. Only pups can be won over.
screen.dogs-unleashed.dog_inspect.shunne: This pack will never trust you.
info.dogs-unleashed.tennis_ball: A fetch toy. Sneak + right-click one of your tamed dogs while holding it to start play mode, then throw it: your dog chases the ball down, picks it up, and drops it back at your feet.
info.dogs-unleashed.stick: Doubles as a fetch toy. Sneak + right-click one of your tamed dogs while holding a stick to start play mode, then throw it for them to retrieve. No crafting needed.
info.dogs-unleashed.frisbee:
The long-range fetch toy: it glides roughly three times further than a tennis ball before landing, which makes it the best choice in open terrain.

Craft it with four honeycomb around a dye. The frisbee keeps the colour of the dye used, and all 16 colours are craftable.
info.dogs-unleashed.dog_bed:
Place a dog bed, then sneak + right-click your tamed dog and right-click the bed to assign it to them.

An assigned dog auto-sleeps at night while it is within 32 blocks in clear weather, and stays asleep until you right-click the bed or give it a new command. Sneak + right-click the bed to unassign the dog.
info.dogs-unleashed.dog_house:
A roomier alternative to the dog bed, assigned the same way: sneak + right-click your tamed dog, then right-click the house.

A dog that sleeps in a house curls up inside it and wakes rested, gaining Regeneration for 30 seconds. It also counts as a closer bed when deciding whether to turn in for the night.
info.dogs-unleashed.dog_grave:
When a tamed dog dies, a grave appears near where it fell, marked with the dog's name and a flower matching its collar colour.

Mine the grave with a pickaxe to collect it as an item that keeps the name, id and collar colour, then place it anywhere as a memorial. Broken without a pickaxe, the grave is lost.

Right-click the grave holding a Totem of Undying to lean it against the headstone, then place a Lightning Rod in the block directly above. When lightning strikes the rod, the ritual spends the totem, the rod and the grave itself, and the pet returns as an undead version of itself. Right-click the grave empty-handed at any time to take the totem back.

A dog that dies while undead is lost for good. Its grave stays as a memorial, and the ritual fizzles on it.
info.dogs-unleashed.dog_treat:
A baked biscuit for a dog that already trusts you. Right-click one of your own tamed dogs while holding a treat and they eat it on the spot, with a bark, a tail wag and a burst of hearts.

For the next 60 seconds that dog moves 10% faster and hits 1 point harder. Feeding again refreshes the full 60 seconds rather than stacking, and the buff survives saves, reloads and dimension changes.

Just holding a treat draws every dog in range: they head tilt, bark and walk over exactly as they do for taming and breeding food, and your own dogs wag their tails too. A treat still cannot tame or breed a dog.

Craft four at a time from wheat, bone meal and sugar in any arrangement.
info.dogs-unleashed.dog_whistle:
A brass whistle on a cord that answers to exactly one dog.

Right-click one of your own tamed dogs while holding it and the whistle binds to that dog, engraving its name into the tooltip. Right-click in the air after that and the dog comes to you from wherever it is, chunk-loading its last known position and crossing dimensions if it has to. Right-click a different dog of yours to move the binding across.

The binding lives on the whistle itself, so it survives saves and reloads, and a player can carry one whistle per dog. Blowing an unbound whistle, or one whose dog has died, says so above the hotbar.

Sneak and right-click while looking at something up to 64 blocks away to point the dog at it. It runs to a block and stays there, attacks a hostile or neutral mob, or picks up a dropped item and brings it back. It ignores players, villagers, iron golems, tamed pets, named or leashed animals, creepers, ghasts, and items another player threw.

Craft one from a gold ingot above a piece of string above any colour of wool.
info.dogs-unleashed.taming_food: Feed to a wild Dogs Unleashed dog to tame it, with a 1-in-3 chance per feed. Dire wolves are different: only a pup can be won over, and it takes many feeds to earn its trust. A naming screen opens the moment the dog is tamed. Hold one near a wild dog and it will tilt its head at you.
info.dogs-unleashed.breeding_food:
Feed to two tamed Dogs Unleashed dogs to breed them. Both parents must be tamed and not sitting, and puppies inherit their coat, size and temperament from both sides. Breeding two different breeds produces a mixed-breed dog, except dire wolves, which only breed with each other.

Feeding a hurt dog heals it instead.
info.dogs-unleashed.husky_spawn_egg: Huskies never bark. They howl instead, and only on nights with a full moon: 4.5 seconds of howl on a 30 second cooldown. They are the only breed with eye colour variants.
info.dogs-unleashed.dachshund_spawn_egg: The smallest breed in the pack, and the slowest, but also the easiest to run into because it turns up across ordinary grassland.
info.dogs-unleashed.beagle_spawn_egg: A mid-sized scent hound with twelve coat patterns, the widest coat range of any breed in the mod.
info.dogs-unleashed.goldenretriever_spaw: The classic fetch dog and the sturdiest breed after the Husky. Only found on beaches, so bring a boat.
info.dogs-unleashed.shibainu_spawn_egg: The fastest breed in the pack, and the hardest to find: cherry groves only.
info.dogs-unleashed.direwolf_spawn_egg: The rarest find in the mod: dire wolves roam only the coldest peaks, slopes and ice fields, and only in packs of five to ten. A pup grows into a yearling, then an adult bigger than any other dog, then a prime the size of a horse. A prime only becomes an alpha, bigger still, after it has won 20 battles beside you and eaten an Enchanted Golden Apple. They bark, howl and growl, hunt and fight as a pack, and only breed with each other. Only a pup can be tamed: sneak close, feed it and hunt beside it until it trusts you, while its pack watches.

screen.dogs-unleashed.settings.badhairda: How often a trim goes wrong. 100% is normal, 0% means every trim is clean.
How fast a dire wolf grows from pup to yearling, from yearling to adult and from adult to prime. 0% stops them growing on their own.
How many hostile mobs a tamed prime must defeat near its owner before an Enchanted Golden Apple turns it into an Alpha.
The fewest dire wolves in a wild pack. Every wild dire wolf comes with a pack of between this and Largest Pack wolves, however it spawns.
The most dire wolves in a wild pack. Every wild dire wolf comes with a pack of between Smallest Pack and this many wolves, however it spawns.
Wild adult and prime dire wolves hunt animals, skeletons and zombies nearby. Animals that are tamed, named, on a lead or near a fence or wall are left alone.
When anything hurts a wild dire wolf, every adult and prime in its pack attacks back. Pups and yearlings keep away. A pack never forgives a player who hurts it.
Sprinting on a dire wolf uses up its stamina. Turn this off to sprint for as long as you like.
How much stamina a ridden dire wolf has, so how long it can sprint.
How fast a dire wolf gets its stamina back after sprinting.
